visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a black jacket over a tan top and black shorts, stands in a warehouse aisle lined with high metal shelves. She holds a large yellow and red bag of pet food, smiling and looking directly at the camera. The setting is brightly lit with overhead warehouse lights. (2) Exterior shot of a large white Costco warehouse building under a blue sky with soft clouds. The camera tilts upward to show the red and blue brand logo. (3) Back inside the warehouse, the woman walks quickly through wide aisles, passing tall racks of beverages and bulk goods. She picks up a green supplement box and holds it toward the lens. Text overlays in green and white appear over the scene. (4) A screen recording of a mobile application interface appears, showing a white background with product photos, prices, and a red notification badge. The UI is clean and minimalist. (5) The woman points her finger toward a lower shelf filled with various Lego toy boxes. A single yellow oversized plastic block sits on the concrete floor in the foreground. (6) Another screen recording shows a scrolling list of products within an app, categorized by sections like 'Bedding' and 'Cleaning,' with red discount labels visible. (7) In the pharmacy section of the warehouse, the woman holds two boxes of supplements. Background figures of other shoppers with carts are visible but blurred. She wears a silver heart necklace and a silver bracelet. (8) In an indoor home setting, she sits at a desk with a laptop and phone. She holds her phone up to show the app, then picks up a potato chip from a bag labeled 'Potato Chips' and eats it while looking thoughtfully at the camera.

(3) [Subtitle]: 但真的比較便宜嗎？我們到好市多實測結果發現！ (4) [Variety]: 非會員價格 高了將近 30%. (5) [Subtitle]: 如果你是會員 搭配上特價的話 差價就不會這麼多！ (6) [Slogan]: 所以如果是好市多會員 又不想去賣場人擠人 偶爾就打開 Uber Eats 滑一下吧！ (7) [Subtitle]: 但如果只是為了省年費都用外送的話 反而更花錢喔！ (8) [Variety]: Uber Eats 都點得到欸！應該吧.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to inform viewers about the availability of Costco products on Uber Eats while providing a cost-benefit analysis between non-member app prices and member in-store prices. It serves as a lifestyle consumer guide, encouraging convenience for existing members while warning non-members about higher markups.
